ruling.explanation:
Rider-filed route-deviation dispute on trip TRP-00107 (Ang Mo Kio to One Raffles Place, 18 July 2026).

To the rider: your claim is upheld in part. The platform's optimal route between the recorded pickup and dropoff is 14.00 km (EV-TRIP-00107). The GPS trace EV-GPS-00107 records a driven distance of 17.57 km, so the excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the deviation is established. I use the trace figure, as POL-RD-01 requires; the rounded 17.6 km on the trip record is not used for the threshold test.

To the driver: your explanation does not exonerate this. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory naming the affected road or segment with an overlapping validity window. EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING from the pool (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening — and a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic-advisory ID, does not discharge your burden under POL-RD-08. No rider-requested detour applies either: the sole rider message in EV-CHAT-00107 challenges the Whitley exit rather than requesting it, and both messages carry a null waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test could not be run.

On the impaired trace: EV-GPS-00107 is tagged IMPAIRED by the admissibility pre-pass at weight 0.30, with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final approach into Raffles Place). That is a schema-level impairment only. POL-RD-07's policy limbs — a gap over 90 s, a jump over 500 m, or a sustained interval over 30 s — are not met, so the trace remains usable to establish the deviation and no straight-line substitution is triggered. The discount therefore bears on confidence only (POL-GEN-02(2)). It does not breach the 0.70 floor, because the deciding fact is carried independently of the trace: the chat log EV-CHAT-00107, a contemporaneous record made inside the trip window (weight 1.0), and your own account admitting you went by Newton and Kim Seng. The confidence cap is the maximum of the independent carriers, 1.00, not the trace's 0.30, and the finding survives the discount.

Refund under POL-RD-02 (fare_model METERED on EV-FARE-00107):
- charged_total: SGD 36.60
- recomputed_fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = SGD 29.177
- refund: 36.60 - 29.177 = SGD 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45

That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis, so it is not NO_ACTION, and at 20.3% of charged_total it is well below the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND. EV-FARE-00107 carries no ERP, toll or surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top and nothing is double-counted. No driver compensation is due: the billed distance (17.60 km) is not short of the trace (17.57 km).

POL-RD-06: the deviation is not MATERIAL (25.5% is below 50% and 3.57 km is below 8.0 km), and the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 619 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The remaining profile counters on either side (rating, lifetime totals, prior dispute and no-show counters, cancellation rate, acceptance rate, region) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no finding about this trip.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
